_note: Pilot 1 (round 2 design 3.9, graded world design 3.9, shape world design 1.3): SEED + 1, P sessions of the step's world; the L300 part (PC1 and the PC-stall of each candidate on [0] + the grid), the L1800 part (PC1-1800 and PCl- of each candidate) and the L300r part (PCrl- and PCrv- of each candidate), no null. A stopped L300 part stops the step; a stopped L1800 part leaves L1800 undecidable (pilot_stop); the L300r part never stops.
